senses.gloss: हर्म्य- + अङ्गण हर्म्य- + अङ्गण, n. the court of a palace.
हरित- + अश्मन् हरित- + अश्मन्, n. 1. blue vitriol. 2. a turquoise; an emerald.
हरिण- + कलङ्क हरिण- + कलङ्क, m. the moon.

हरि- + गण हरि- + गण, m.
 1. a troop of horse, Rājat. 5, 142.
 2. a proper name, ib.

हरि- + चन्दन हरि- + चन्दन,
 I. m. and n. 1. A yellow and fragrant sort of sandal-wood. 2. a tree of paradise.
 II. n. 1. saffron. 2. moonlight. 3. the farina of the lotus. 4. the person of a beloved one.
हरिण- + धामन् हरिण- + धामन्, m. the moon, Rājat. 5, 482.
हरिण- + नर्तक हरिण- + नर्तक, m. a Kiṃnara.
हर्म्य- + पृष्ठ हर्म्य- + पृष्ठ, n. the upper room of a palace, Vikr. 38, 11.

हरि- + प्रिय हरि- + प्रिय,
 I. m. 1. Śiva. 2. a foot. 3. armour.
 II. f. या, Lakṣmī.
हार- + यष्टि हार- + यष्टि, f. a necklace, Ṛt. 1, 8.
हरिद्रा- + राग हरिद्रा- + राग, adj. fickle, unsteady.
हरि- + लोचन हरि- + लोचन, m. 1. a crab. 2. an owl.
हरि- + वाहन हरि- + वाहन, m. 1. Garuḍa. 2. Indra, Indr. 5, 54.
हर- + वीज हर- + वीज, n. quicksilver.
हरि- + वीज हरि- + वीज, n. yellow orpiment.
हरि- + शर हरि- + शर, m. Śiva.

हरि- + हय हरि- + हय, m. 1. Indra, Johns. Sel. 19, 88.
 2. the sun.
 3. Skanda, the god of war.
 4. Ganeśa.

हर हर, i. e. हृ + अ,
 I. adj. Taking, Pañc. i. d. 278; seizing, carrying, Kir. 5, 50; depriving of (विभ्रम-, [] surpassing the beauty), Bhartṛ. 1, 5.
 II. m.
 1. Śiva, Vikr. d. 48.
 2. Agni.
 3. An ass (cf. खर).
 --Comp.

हार हार, i. e. partly ह्रि + अ,
 I. adj. Who or what takes.
 II. m.
 1. Taking.
 2. A porter.
 3. A string of pearls, Pañc. 52, 22; 53, 1.
 4. War, battle.
 --Comp.

हरक हरक, i. e. हृ + अक, m.
 1. A taker.
 2. A rogue.
 3. A person of reflection.
 4. Śiva.

हारक हारक, i. e. हृ + अक,
 I. adj. Taking, drawing upon one's self, Man. 8, 308.
 II. m.
 1. A thief, a plunderer, Rājat. 5, 451.
 2. A rogue.
 3. i. e. कार + क, A string of pearls, Pañc. 176, 3.
 --Comp.

हरण हरण, i. e. हृ + अन,
 I. m. The hand.
 II. n.
 1. Taking, seizing, Pañc. iv. d. 28; carrying away, Pañc. ii. d. 111; 112; removing, Hit. ii. d. 155; stealing, Man. 8, 323.
 2. Withholding, Hit. iii. d. 90.
 3. Annulling. disregarding, Rājat. 5, 180.
 4. The arm.
 5. Accepting.
 6. A special gift, as a nuptial present.
 7. Semen virile.
 8. Gold.
 9. Boiling water.
 --Comp.

हरि हरि (curtailed हरित्),
 I. adj.
 1. Green.
 2. Tawny.
 3. Yellow, Indr. 1, 7; Arj. 4, 12.
 II. m.
 1. Green, tawny, yellow, the colour.
 2. Viṣṇu or Kṛṣṇa, Hit. pr. d. 28, M.M.; Pañc. pr. d. 1.
 3. Indra, Śāk. d. 156.
 4. Śiva.
 5. Yama.
 6. The sun, Mālat. 149, 1.
 7. The moon.
 8. A ray of light.
 9. Fire.
 10. Wind.
 11. A horse (of Indra; cf. the ved. use of हरित्, and Śāk. 6, 5); Arj. 4, 32.
 12. A lion, Vikr. d. 16.
 13. A parrot.
 14. The Indian cuckoo.
 15. A peacock.
 16. A goose.
 17. An ape, Utt. Rāmac. 84, 9.
 18. A frog.
 19. A snake.
 20. One of the वर्षस्, or divisions, into which the continent is divided.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. A.S. growan; O.H.G. grôen, grôni; A.S. groen, grene; also geal, gealla; Lat. gilvus; χολή, and probably χλόα; cf. हरित्.

हारि हारि,
 I. i. e. हृ + इ, adj. Handsome.
 II. f.
 1. A caravan.
 2. Defeat in war or gambling.
 III. f. री, A pearl.
हरिक हरि + क, m. A horse of a yellowish-blue tint.

हरिण (akin to हरित्, cf. हरि),
 I. adj., f. णी, Yellowish-white, MBh. 13, 5893; Rājat. 5, 482.
 II. m.
 1. Yellowish-white (the colour).
 2. White.
 3. A deer, an antelope, Pañc. 140, 23.
 4. A goose.
 5. Viṣṇu, Śiva.
 6. A minor division of the world.
 III. f. णी.
 1. A doe, Megh. 80; 102.
 2. Yellow jasmine.
 3. A beautiful woman.
 4. A golden image, Rājat. 5, 15.
हारिण हारिण, i. e. हरिण + अ, adj. Relating to deer. Man. 3, 268 (venison).
हरिणक हरिण + क, m. A deer, Śāk. d. 10; Utt. Rāmac. 67, 5.
हरिणाय हरिणाय, a denomin. derived from हरिण, with य, Ātm. To become a deer, Śṛṅgārat. 13.

हरित् हरित् (for original हरन्त्, cf. हिरण),
 I. adj. Green.
 II. m.
 1. Green, the colour.
 2. A horse of the sun (properly, his rays), Chr. 287, 8 = Rigv. i. 50, 8.
 3. A lion.
 4. The sun, Śāk. 6, 5.
 5. Viṣṇu.
 6. Kidney bean.
 III. m. and n. Grass.
 IV. f.
 1. A quarter, or point of the compass, Śiś. 9, 28.
 2. Turmeric.
 --Cf. χάριτες; Goth. gulth; A.S. gold (see हरि, Yellow, and हिरण); akin is also Goth. glitmunjan, To shine; cf. also χόρτος; Goth. gras; A.S. graes.

हरित हरित,
 I. adj., f. ता, or इणी (cf. हरिण),
 1. Green, Megh. 21; Hit. i. d. 178, M.M. (in हरिती-कृत, adj. Made green)
 2. Dark blue, Kir. 5, 38.
 3. Grassy.
 II. m.
 1. Green, the colour.
 2. A lion.
 III. f. ता.
 1. Bent grass.
 2. Turmeric.
 3. A brown grape.

हारित हारित, i. e. हरित् + अ, m.
 1. Green, the colour.
 2. The green pigeon, Lass. 2. ed. 52, 34.

हारीत हारीत (cf. हारित), m.
 1. The green pigeon, Ragh. 4, 46.
 2. A Muni, author of a law book.
 3. A rogue.

हरिताल हरिताल, i. e. हरित + आल,
 I. n. Yellow orpiment.
 II. f. ली.
 1. [] Bent grass.
 2. A line in the sky.
 3. A sort of creeper.

हरितालक हरिताल + क,
 I. m. The green pigeon.
 II. f. लिका.
 1. A sort of grass.
 2. The fourth lunar day of the month Bhadra.
 III. n. Theatrical decoration of the person.
हरिदश्व हरिदश्व, i. e. हरित्-अश्व, m. The sun, Kir. 2, 46.
हरिद्रा हरिद्रा, f. Turmeric, Sch. ad Vikr. d. 53; MBh. 3, 12880; Rājat. 5, 381.

हारिद्र हारिद्र, i. e. हरिद्रा + अ,
 I. adj.
 1. Stained with turmeric.
 2. Yellow.
 II. m.
 1. Yellow, the colour.
 2. The Kadamba tree.
हरिन्मणि हरिन्मणि, i. e. हरित्-मणि, m. An emerald, Kir. 6, 23; 14, 41.
हरिभुज् हरि-भुज्, m. A snake (properly, eating frogs).

हरिमन् हरिमन्, m.
 I. i. e. हरि + इमन्, Paleness, Chr. 289, 11 = Rigv. i. 50, 11.
 II. i. e. हृ + इमन्, Time.
हरिय हरिय (derived from हरि), m. A horse of yellow colour.
हरिले हरिले, A term of calling a female slave (in theatrical language).
हरिवन्त् हरि + वन्त्, m. Indra.
हरिश्चन्द्र हरि-श्चन्द् + र (see चन्द्), m. The name of a king.
हरिहेतिहूति हरि-हेति-हूति (हरि-हेति, The weapon of Viṣṇu, i. e. चक्र, the discus, and हूति = वाक), m. = चक्र-वाक, A kind of duck, Śiś. 9, 15.
हरीतक हरीतक (derived from हरित्), m., f. की, Yellow or chebulic myrobalan, Terminalia Chebula, Lass. 2. ed. 51, 33 (क).
हारीतक हारीत + क, m. The green pigeon (ŚKD.), Pañc. 158, 21.

हरेणु हरेणु,
 I. m. Peas, pulse.
 II. f.
 1. A sort of drug and perfume.
 2. A reputable woman.

हर्तृ हर्तृ, i. e. हृ + तृ, m., f. त्री, [] and n.
 1. One who takes, seizes, a robber, Man. 8, 342.
 2. One who brings, Mālat. 150, 10.
 --Comp.
हर्मन् हर्मन्, n. Yawning.

हर्मित हर्मित, adj.
 1. Thrown.
 2. Burned (cf. घर्म).
 3. Yawned (cf. the last).

हर्म्य हर्म्य, n. A palace, Vikr. d. 56; a mansion, a house, Pañc. ii. d. 63.
 --Comp.

हर्य् हर्य्, i. 1, Par.
 1. To take, ved., cf. हृ.
 2. † To go.
 3. † To desire.
 4. † To be weary.
 --Cf. χαίρω, γέλως, γελάω; Goth. gailjan, gôljan; A.S. gal, gagol; see हृ, and cf. हृष्.
हर्यत हर्यत, m. A horse.
हर्यश्व हर्यश्व, i. e. हरि-अश्व, m. Indra.

हर्ष हर्ष, i. e. हृष् + अ,
 I. adj., f. षा, Delighted, happy, Mālav. 60, 5.
 II. m. Joy, Daśak. in Chr. 183, 12; exultation, Hit. i. d. 32, M.M.; happiness, Pañc. iii. d. 188.
 --Comp.

हर्षक हर्षक, i. e. हृष् + अक,
 I. adj. Delighting.
 II. m. The name of a mountain.

हर्षण हर्षण, i. e. हृष् + अन,
 I. adj. Delighting.
 II. m.
 1. A cause of pleasure.
 2. A morbid affection of the eyes.
 III. n. Rejoicing.
 --Comp.[]

हर्षयित्नु हर्षयित्नु, i. e. हृष्, Caus., + त्नु,
 I. adj. Delighting.
 II. m. A child.
 III. (m. ?), Gold.

हर्षुल हर्षुल, i. e. हृष् + उल,
 I. adj. Delighted, Rājat. 5, 473.
 II. m.
 1. A lover.
 2. A deer.
हार् हार्, a denomin. derived from the next, Par. To behave or be like a string of pearls, Lass. 67, 16.

हारहूर हारहूर,
 I. m. Vinous liquor.
 II. f. रा, A grape.

हारिकण्ठ हारिकण्ठ, cf. हारी, s. v. हारि, and कण्ठ,
 I. adj. Wearing a necklace.
 II. m. The Indian cuckoo.
हारिणिक हारिणिक, i. e. हरिण + इक, m. A hunter.
हारिद्रव हारिद्रव, m. A tree, [] Curcuma zanthorizon, Chr. 289, 12 = Rigv. i. 50, 12.

हारिन् हारिन्, i. e. हृ + इन्, adj., f. इणी,
 1. Taking, Man. 8, 308.
 2. Robbing, Pañc. i. d. 31.
 3. Agitating (with gen.), Man. 12, 28.
 4. Captivating, Śāk. d. 5; charming, Pañc. i. d. 303; Daśak. in Chr. 196, 19; delighting, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 3288.
 5. Pleasant, Kathās. 22, 103.
 6. Bringing, Śāk. 61, 9.
 --Comp.

हार्द हार्द, i. e. हृद् + अ, n.
 1. Affection, love, Vikr. d. 148; kindness.
 2. Will, Bhāg. P. 1, 7, 55.
 --Comp.
हरिण- + हृदय हरिण- + हृदय, adj. fearful.
